FEAT4-ST-007.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
FEAT4-ST-007.description: Create structured response schema for provider detail lookup including demographics, credentials, practice locations, and external links (state boards, research profiles).

FEAT4-ST-008.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Logic
FEAT4-ST-008.description: Build core logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider data, and normalize fields into internal schema.

FEAT4-ST-009.title: Construct External Provider Links (State Boards and Research)
FEAT4-ST-009.description: Generate state medical board URLs and research site links based on provider metadata (state, name, NPI) for inclusion in response.

FEAT4-ST-010.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
FEAT4-ST-010.description: Integrate provider detail service into EvaluateCare facade and tool routing layer for LLM access.

FEAT4-ST-011.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
FEAT4-ST-011.description: Create tests validating NPI lookup, schema correctness, external link construction, and facade integration.
